communityNodeAdvisory.title: Community Node advisory
communityNodeAdvisory.nodeLocalNotice: Information from the selected Community Node only. It is not a network-wide judgment and does not hide this author by default.
communityNodeAdvisory.noNodes: An authenticated, consented Community Node that provides trust advisories is required. Check your node settings.

appeal.title: Appeal a risk assessment
appeal.description: Ask the Community Node that issued this assessment to review it.
appeal.unsupportedTarget: This type of risk assessment cannot be appealed from the current screen.
appeal.endpoint: Send to the node's report endpoint
appeal.boundary: This appeal is sent only to the assessment issuer {{issuer}}. It is not sent to any other node.
appeal.anonymous: No contact details or information that identifies you will be sent.
appeal.detailsPlaceholder: Explain why you believe this assessment is incorrect. Do not include personal information.
appeal.success: Your appeal was accepted. The latest assessment basis has been reloaded.
appeal.invalidAppeal: The assessment could not be verified or has already been resolved. Reload the information and check its status.
appeal.responseMismatch: The accepted appeal does not match the submitted assessment. The state was not changed; reload the information.
appeal.unresolvedTitle: The issuer's destination could not be resolved
appeal.unresolvedBody: No configured node with the issuer's node_id and a report_endpoint was found. Check your node settings.
appeal.noneContribution: This assessment currently contributes to the trust result. It continues to contribute until the operator clears the appeal.
appeal.disputedContribution: This appeal is under review. The assessment continues to contribute until it is cleared.
appeal.clearedContribution: The appeal was accepted. This assessment no longer contributes to the trust result.

errors.trust_not_activated: Trust advisory reads are not active for your current node session.
errors.relation_unavailable: Relation information is unavailable from this Community Node. The reason is intentionally not disclosed.
errors.relation_visibility_not_configured: This Community Node does not provide relation distance opt-out.
errors.relation_visibility_not_activated: Relation distance opt-out is temporarily unavailable on this Community Node.
errors.auth_required: Authenticate with the selected Community Node first.
errors.consent_required: Accept the required policies of the selected Community Node first.
errors.response_mismatch: The node answered for a different user, so the response was not used.
